title: DuckDB
scope: A complete DuckDB course covering embedded analytical SQL, CLI and APIs, rich/nested types, advanced SQL, transactions and concurrency, storage/checkpoint internals, vectorized execution and optimization, profiling, CSV/JSON/Parquet, HTTP/S3 and secrets, extensions, Python/Arrow/Polars/Pandas integration, database connectors, spatial/FTS/vector search, Iceberg, DuckLake, partitioned data lakes, performance/memory/spilling, deployment patterns, and production capstones.
coverage_note: Current DuckDB 1.5.x-era capabilities, core extensions, Iceberg/DuckLake workflows, embedded concurrency model, profiling, file/object-store analytics, and forward-looking remote access concepts
